business.headline: Air India shifts west-bound traffic to Mumbai: What's behind the move?Acknowledging the impact of regional airspace restrictions, Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam told employees during a town hall that the airline was redesigning parts of its network to improve efficiency and minimise disruptions.

PhonePe revives IPO plans, targets $15 billion valuation for 2027 listingThe proposed IPO is expected to be entirely an offer for sale (OFS), meaning existing shareholders will sell part or all of their holdings rather than the company issuing fresh shares to raise money.

India needs 80 lakh jobs a year: Can cheaper imports be the answer?Millions of young Indians are entering the workforce, but are there enough jobs waiting for them? Could cheaper imports help India tackle its growing employment challenge?

TVS family feud: Lakshmi Venu open to settlement despite 'ship has sailed' remarkLakshmi Venu remains willing to discuss an amicable property settlement with her family. The court battle centres on a disputed 5:95 division and daughters' equal rights.

94% of popular online platforms still use dark patterns despite govt crackdownA LocalCircles study found dark patterns on 334 of 354 online platforms examined across India. The findings reveal a wide compliance gap before amended e-commerce rules take effect.

Sensex ends 1,502 points higher, Nifty above 25,800; HUL up 6%The Sensex surged 1,502.29 points, or 1.82%, to close at 83,938.28. The index had opened at 83,436.89 and moved between an intraday low of 83,380.75 and a high of 84,498.21. The Nifty gained 469.60 points, or 1.85%, to settle at 25,819.25.

Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down after 11 yearsKrishnamurthy took over as Flipkart CEO in January 2017 and was elevated to Group CEO in 2018, leading the company's expansion across key businesses.

TVS succession row: Lakshmi Venu files suit seeking partition of father's assetsIn the suit, Lakshmi has sought the partition of joint family assets belonging to the Venu Srinivasan branch of the TVS family and the allotment of her rightful share.

Nvidia, Trump and a boardroom precedent that could worry companies worldwideA CEO is back, a President is taking credit, and Nvidia's board is facing questions about its independence. Could this set a precedent for corporate boardrooms worldwide?

Tamil Nadu eyes over Rs 50,000 crore investments across sectorsIn August, the Tamil Nadu government signed nearly 100 investment agreements at its first investor meeting since Chief Minister Joseph Vijay took office.

Air India CEO Tewolde gets go-ahead for major leadership shake-up: ReportTata Sons chairman has given Tewolde Gebremariam the freedom to build his own leadership team, including hiring senior executives from outside the company who have experience in running large airlines, says report.

GTA V to GTA VI: How India became an electronics manufacturing powerhouseMore than a decade separates GTA V and GTA VI, but those years also saw India emerge as a major electronics manufacturing hub. How did that transformation happen?

Sensex surges nearly 2,000 points, Rs 4 lakh crore added: Why stock markets are rallyingWhile concerns over an AI bubble and the sustainability of massive investments in AI infra continue to trigger sharp swings in technology-heavy markets, Dalal Street has found its footing, with foreign investors returning, corporate earnings improving and lower crude oil prices offering support.

Bulls take charge on Dalal Street as Sensex, Nifty rally amid global jittersThe Sensex was up 1,363.85 points, or 1.65%, at 83,799.84. It opened at 83,436.89, against its previous close of 82,435.99, and climbed to an early high of 83,869.60. The Nifty 50 rose 388.90 points, or 1.53%, to 25,738.55 as of 9:24 am.

Joining WhatsApp stock tip groups? Sebi lists 11 ways to spot fake trading scamsSebi has warned investors against fake WhatsApp and Telegram groups impersonating registered intermediaries. The alert highlights deceptive trading offers and urges verification through official regulatory resources.

RBI's new digital fraud rules: What changes for your bank account, cards, transfers?One of the biggest changes is a proposed 'Stop Switch' facility that would allow customers to immediately disable all future customer-initiated debits from their accounts. The RBI has also proposed a Trusted Person Mechanism, under which another person chosen by the customer could be asked to approve certain high-value fund transfers.

Claude maker Anthropic crashes below $83 IPO price, putting $200 billion at riskAnthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price days after a record Nasdaq debut. The reversal intensified concerns over AI valuations, insider selling and infrastructure costs.

Donald Trump plans fresh US tariffs on India, China and 14 other nationsThe Trump administration is preparing higher tariffs on India and 15 other major economies over industrial subsidies. The timing of this development is especially delicate in view of the fact that New Delhi and Washington are still trying to negotiate their bilateral trade deal.

India, China importing record oil from Russia in 2026. Why the surge may not lastIndia and China are set to import record volumes of Russian crude as the Iran war disrupts Middle Eastern supplies. The surge supports Moscow's revenues, but traders expect demand to weaken in 2027.

RBI's new banking fraud safeguards: Proposes Stop Switch, trusted person checksThe RBI has proposed a Stop Switch and trusted-person approval for specified bank transfers. The draft seeks stronger customer control and broader accountability for digital payment fraud.

entertainment.headline: Rs 24 in his bank account, Rs 1 crore on KBC: Meet season 18's first crorepati Bhushan Thakare became Kaun Banega Crorepati 18's first crorepati after arriving in Mumbai with Rs 24 in his bank account. His decade-long pursuit has secured funds to resume UPSC preparation and support his family.

Our religion, not beach accessory: Internet schools Kendall Jenner over 'Om' sarong Kendall Jenner faced criticism after wearing an Om and Trishul-printed sarong, sparking a debate on cultural sensitivity and respect. Many argue that religious icons like Om should not be treated as fashion accessories, highlighting the need for awareness and respect towards spiritual traditions.

He wanted to kill me: Ravi Kishan recalls father's fury over acting on KWK 9 Actor-politician Ravi Kishan opened up about his early struggles on Koffee With Karan Season 9 alongside Akshay Kumar. He recalled how his father violently opposed his acting ambitions in the 1990s, forcing his mother to help him leave home.

Honey Singh, Atif Aslam dance at Dubai wedding amid Pak show ban row Singers Honey Singh and Atif Aslam danced to Abrar-ul-Haq's songs at a Dubai wedding, with the event host sharing photos and videos, while referencing the ongoing ban calls against Pakistani Netflix series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo.

Doctor jailed for negligence that led to Ismail Darbar's mother's death in 2009 A Surat court sentenced Paresh Bhajiawala to two years in prison for medical negligence. The verdict concludes a 17-year legal battle over Ismail Darbar's mother, Zaitoon Bibi's death.

Producer alleges police harassment during Indore shoot, cops deny claims A web series shoot in Indore ended in a dispute after producer Kapil Khadiwala accused Indore police of disrupting filming and demanding money. Indore Police Commissioner Santosh Singh dismissed the allegations as misleading and said a notice had been issued to the producer.

Trump backs Robert Pattinson as Bond, revisits old Kristen Stewart tweet Donald Trump wished Robert Pattinson luck as James Bond during an Oval Office interview. He also revisited his 2012 comments on Pattinson's relationship with Kristen Stewart.

Here is why film bodies are objecting its release in the country.

O Saathi Re trailer: Arjun's entry strains Aditi-Avinash marriage Netflix unveiled the O Saathi Re trailer, tracing Roshni and Karan's marriage towards divorce. Arjun Rampal's character deepens their conflict as Roshni seeks an identity beyond prescribed roles.

SS Rajamouli's Varanasi to skip April 2027 release over VFX, post-production delay SS Rajamouli's Varanasi may miss its April 2027 release as extensive VFX work continues. The announced date remains unchanged pending official confirmation from the makers.

Nathan Fielder reveals why he agreed to make Elizabeth Holmes documentary Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim filmed Elizabeth Holmes and her family for three years. The documentary examines the divide between her public persona and private presentation.

Ramayana in Oscars Best Visual Effects longlist beside Doomsday, Dune 3, The Odyssey Director Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Rise of a Legend has secured a place on the 20-film Best Visual Effects longlist for the 2027 Academy Awards. Backed by DNEG's VFX work, it competes alongside Dune: Part Three, Avengers: Doomsday, Project Hail Mary, and The Odyssey.

Ramayana set to enter India's Top 4, but is its overseas run losing steam? Director Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana is nearing Pushpa 2's worldwide total after grossing Rs 1,735.15 crore in 20 days. Its shrinking North American footprint puts greater weight on upcoming international releases.

Orry gets threats for staying silent on TV actors Avinash Mishra, Eisha Singh's split Orry said he received aggressive messages and threats demanding comment on Avinash Mishra and Eisha Singh's breakup. He urged people to respect their privacy as Avinash apologised over his controversial DJ performance.

Bhogi director justifies violence in film amid censor board's concerns Director Sampath Nandi said Bhogi's violent sequences arise naturally from its story amid the film's CBFC review. The referral delayed promotions and shifted the Sharwanand-starrer's theatrical release to November 27.

He would wait in her make-up room: Filmmaker on Mithun-Sridevi dating rumours Cinematographer-filmmaker Lawrence D'Souza recalled how Mithun Chakraborty would visit Sridevi on the sets of Gair Kanooni and wait in her make-up room. He mentioned that their equation was widely known in the industry back then.

Who knew? Kareena's 90s throwback shows Saif dancing with future sister-in-law Karisma Kareena Kapoor shared a throwback clip of Saif Ali Khan dancing with Karisma Kapoor. The amusing family connection accompanied her excitement for Sooraj Barjatya's upcoming film.

Mahabharata's Eklavya to be played by AI-generated actor in new series The Mahabharata's Eklavya is getting a new screen avatar in an upcoming AI-led series. Directed by filmmaker Vibhu Puri, the show is set to premiere in 2027.

Shiv Sena leader joins call to ban Fawad-Mahira's Pakistani Netflix series in India Shiv Sena leader Anand Dubey has echoed the All India Cine Workers Association's (AICWA) appeal to prevent Netflix's Pakistani series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samet Lo from streaming in India. Dubey said India has no interest in cricket or web series from the neighbouring country.

general news.headline: India rejects US claims that its policies fuel excess manufacturing capacityHours after the Trump administration announced fresh tariffs on India, New Delhi rejected Washington's allegations of excess manufacturing capacity, insisting that trade concerns be resolved through bilateral negotiations.

WhatsApp rolls out scheduled messages for individual, group chats: How to use itThe Meta-owned messaging platform has started rolling out scheduled messages, allowing users to prepare texts, photos and videos in advance and choose when they should be delivered. The feature works in both individual and group chats, making it easier to remember birthdays, send important updates and stay in touch with people living in different time zones.

Why US is attacking Make in India, Atmanirbhar Bharat in new tariff threatThe US Trade Representative has determined that India's acts, policies and practices relating to structural excess capacity and production are "unreasonable" and burden or restrict US commerce. It has proposed tariffs of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods, to which New Delhi has responded by rejecting the charge.

US Army blows up tons of bomb-making chemicals in Iowa, plumes of smoke seen in skyThe controlled explosion took place at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, where 68 barrels of highly volatile lead azide had been stored in two earth-covered bunkers for more than two decades.

Anant Singh invited all to daughter's wedding. Chaos arrived, and 10-km-long jam tooBihar strongman and Mokama MLA Anant Singh's open invitation to his daughter Shivangi's wedding drew massive crowds to his ancestral village of Nadwan, triggering a 10-km-long traffic jam. While people climbed electricity towers to watch a horse race, the organisers were forced to postpone the final amid the chaos.

Udaipur man dies dancing at daughter's wedding, marriage held before funeralA man died after suffering a heart attack while dancing at his daughter's bindo li in Udaipur. His family completed the daughter's wedding before conducting his last rites later that day.

PWD to audit 17 Delhi flyovers built in 2004 for structural safetyThe Public Works Department will conduct structural safety audits of 17 flyovers in Delhi built in 2004 to assess their condition and identify repair requirements. The move follows the detection of cracks in the Old Rao Tula Ram flyover in October, which triggered repairs and caused major traffic congestion.

Two Safdarjung Hospital employees assaulted with bat, hammer in Delhi road rageTwo contractual Safdarjung Hospital employees sustained head injuries after two men attacked them with a baseball bat and hammer following a road rage incident near Delhi's Sarai Kale Khan Flyover. Police are verifying the accused's identities and registering an FIR.

Mumbai man claims AstroTalk is scanning your phone for 244 apps. Video goes viralYou went to AstroTalk looking for answers about your love life, career and future. But a marketing consultant's viral video claims the app could already know more about your personal life than you think, and you are not ready for it.

Congress sweeps 24 of 37 Rajasthan Zila Pramukh posts, BJP gets 10Congress won 24 of 37 Zila Pramukh posts in Rajasthan, while the BJP secured 10. Cross-voting and lotteries shaped several close contests, marking another setback for the ruling party.

Return or quit: IBM gives H-1B employees only 2 optionsIBM has ended green card and US visa sponsorship for most roles in its consulting division, leaving affected employees with just two choices: relocate to another country or leave the company. Employees reportedly have only three weeks to decide.

31 killed as petroleum vehicle overturns, triggers massive fire in EgyptAt least 31 people were killed and 21 injured after a vehicle carrying petroleum products overturned and caught fire on a major ring road in Egypt's Giza. The blaze charred 27 vehicles, including cars and motorcycles.

Toyota Innova Hycross facelift launched at Rs 19.59 lakh, gets E85 flex-fuel hybrid optionToyota has launched the Innova Hycross facelift at Rs 19.59 lakh, bringing revised styling, upgraded cabin features and an E85-compatible strong-hybrid flex-fuel powertrain to its MPV lineup.

Adani's Godda plant to shut one unit for 25 days, Bangladesh power supply to halveOne of Adani's two generating power units at its Godda plant in Jharkhand, which supplies 1,496 MW to Bangladesh, is going offline for a scheduled overhaul until December 18. While the maintenance is planned, Bangladesh will have to make do with half the power supply. This comes amid protests and political uncertainties in Bangladesh.

CJI Surya Kant says judiciary must introspect to tackle AI, digital-age challengesChief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant said the judiciary must adapt to emerging challenges such as artificial intelligence, digital arrests and borderless disputes, calling for introspection to ensure speedy and affordable justice.

Nandini curd prices cut by Rs 2 per kg in Karnataka after backlashUnder the revised pricing, the 1 kg pack of Nandini curd, which currently costs Rs 68, will be available for Rs 66. Video: 3 dead, 6 hurt as speeding truck runs over students waiting at Pune bus stopA speeding truck veered off the road and ran over students waiting at a bus stop in Pune, killing three and injuring six. CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced.

Himachal man, 75, marries 63-year-old woman at old-age home where they found loveA man from Himachal Pradesh married a 63-year-old woman after finding companionship at a Bilaspur old-age home. Their late-life union marked a new chapter after years of hardship and loneliness.

Rahul Gandhi's one-tap response to Riteish and Genelia's viral lap photoRahul Gandhi shared Riteish Deshmukh and Genelia D'Souza's playful lap photo in his Instagram story. The actors' gesture echoed his anecdote about his parents Rajiv and Sonia Gandhi's affectionate relationship.

Rohit Sharma, is that you? Mumbai Indians tease IPL 2027 captain announcementIPL 2027: Mumbai Indians sent fans on social media into a frenzy with a cryptic image on Wednesday. Speculation is rife that Rohit Sharma will return as captain of the five-time champions.

sports.headline: Gukesh defends quick draw in Game 2, admits he could not put Sindarov under pressure D Gukesh settled for a second successive draw against Javokhir Sindarov after Game 2 of the FIDE World Chess Championship ended in just 20 moves. Ravindra Jadeja joins Vaibhav Sooryavanshi celebrations with fun edited picture Ravindra Jadeja joined the celebrations after Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's sensational 204 against UAE, sharing a fun edited picture of the teenager on Instagram. Sooryavanshi smashed 28 sixes in his knock to help India A chase down 250 and qualify for the Rising Stars Asia Cup semi-finals.

India women's hockey team scales new heights with historic rise to World No.4 The Indian women's hockey team climbed to a historic World No. 4 in the FIH Rankings after thrashing Japan 4-0 in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 in Bhopal. India broke their own record for the second consecutive day, having reached World No. 5 after defeating China 6-2 on Tuesday.

Wiaan Mulder scripts history as South Africa crush Bangladesh to seal 2-0 series win SA vs BAN: Wiaan Mulder scripted history with a century and a seven-wicket haul as South Africa crushed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs in the second Test in Centurion to complete a 2-0 series sweep.

Riding high on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi storm, India A eye Sri Lanka A heist in semis India A will bank on Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking double century against the UAE as they take on unbeaten Sri Lanka A in the Rising Stars Asia Cup semi-final. Having crashed out in the semi-finals last year, India will be determined to make amends and secure a place in the final.

Mumbai-Goa sailing spectacle: Ocean Gold Cup Season 2 to begin on January 4 The Ocean Gold Cup will return for its second season from January 4 to 10, 2027, featuring a 250-nautical-mile offshore sailing race from Mumbai to Goa. Rohit Sharma, is that you? Mumbai Indians tease IPL 2027 captain announcement IPL 2027: Mumbai Indians sent fans on social media into a frenzy with a cryptic image on Wednesday. Speculation is rife that Rohit Sharma will return as captain of the five-time champions.

Zaheer Khan-owned company to launch mixed-gender T20 league in Germany Zaheer Khan-owned Anchor Sports AB has partnered with the German Cricket Federation to launch a professional mixed-gender T20 league in Germany in August 2027. The inaugural edition will feature five teams, 12 matches and playing XIs comprising six women and five men.

Delhi to host 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup, 2027 World Champs in Olympics style New Delhi will host the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals as the BWF expands its team championships to 24 teams. The World Championships will adopt an Olympic-style group-stage format from 2027, alongside other major changes.

WBBL: Deandra Dottin loses her wicket before facing a ball in bizarre Free Ball twist Deandra Dottin suffered a bizarre dismissal in the WBBL as Sarah Glenn hit the unguarded stumps after the West Indies all-rounder failed to reach the crease within the 75-second time limit. Sooryavanshi's 204 on par with Sehwag's Test triple hundred vs Pakistan: Ex-pacerFormer India fast bowler L Balaji has likened Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's stunning 204 against UAE to Virender Sehwag's historic Test triple century. However, it was his nearly two-year-old son Jack's adorable applause from the stands that stole the show.

ICC Test Rankings: Bumrah closes in on No. 1 return, three Indian batters in top 10Jasprit Bumrah has climbed to joint-second in the ICC Test bowling rankings after his five-wicket haul against New Zealand in Wellington, while three Indian batters, Rishabh Pant, Shubman Gill and Yashasvi Jaiswal, feature in the top 10.

India vs Pakistan: Harbhajan urges ICC to act against shameful player behavioursEx-India spinner Harbhajan Singh has called for the ICC and cricket boards to take action against India and Pakistan players over their conduct on the field, warning that their heated exchanges are sending the wrong message to young cricketers.

Indian women's hockey team achieves highest-ever FIH ranking at World No. 5The Indian women's hockey team scripted history on Tuesday, climbing to a new high of World No. 5 in the FIH rankings after thrashing Olympic silver medallists China 6-2 in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy.

Jannik Sinner's Australian Open participation in doubt after knee operationJannik Sinner's Australian Open participation is in doubt after the Italian underwent surgery on his troublesome right knee on Tuesday, less than two months before the season's first Grand Slam in Melbourne.

Nadal and son's priceless reaction to Bellingham's Real Madrid stunner goes viralRafael Nadal was among those left in awe as Jude Bellingham produced a stunning goal to put Real Madrid ahead against PSV Eindhoven in the Champions League.
